Good to know

Does 614 One confirm that my document conforms to the standards?

No. Standards and legal sources are the basis of the review. Whether your product meets the requirements is assessed by a person; the report says so explicitly.

Which files can I submit?

PDF, Word (DOC, DOCX) and text, up to 20 files per run, 10 MB per file and 20 MB in total. Scanned pages are read with text recognition.

In which language?

German-language documents are reviewed; text recognition is set to German. The reports are in German. The interface is available in German, English, Ukrainian and Russian.

Does the report give exact locations?

Where there is a passage to point to, yes. Page numbers are estimated and marked as such. If content is missing entirely, the report says what is missing instead of inventing a location.

Where are my files stored?

For the review, in the operator's Google Drive and Google Sheets. Retention and deletion are set out in the order.

When can I start?

The pilot with FSH Documentation is prepared. Until it is approved, only fictitious test documents are processed, no customer documents.
